tips.text: Play to the daily cap first, then run the Syndicate Alerts and grab every medallion, since those bypass the cap.
Use Primed Animal Instinct or Thief's Wit to find medallions; Limbo with high range and Khora with two companions are the usual hunting frames.
Run the alerts solo; joining late forfeits the medallions already picked up.
Run an XP booster; pledged standing is a share of affinity, so it doubles.
Equip the highest-percentage Steel Meridian Sigil while you earn standing.
Collect the 5 Aya from Cetus bounties before you reach Protector; waiting on it throws the day's standing away.
Do not farm New Loka or Perrin Sequence at the same time; Steel Meridian drains both and raises Red Veil by half.
Buy the other Vaykor weapons on the same visit; they use the same General rank and give separate Mastery.
Players treat Vaykor Sydon as Mastery fodder; the grind is slow rather than hard, mostly the daily cap and the credits.
